text.arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ طُوبَىٰ لَهُمْ وَحُسْنُ مَـَٔابٍۢ

words.gloss_range: headless masculine plural relative pronoun opening a qualifying clause whose reward predicate arrives later

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: Form IV perfect plural trust verb in the qualifying clause
coordinated perfect plural action verb in the qualifying clause
plural pronoun retrieving the qualified group as reward recipients

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) opens with a headless relative expression, so the ayah does not begin by naming a tribe, class title, or abstract quality. The reader must recover the group from the previous ayah and from the following predicates: they are the ones marked by trust and restorative action. Its plural agreement then carries forward through {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}), {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}), and {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}), turning the prior heart-rest scene into a focused recipient class before the reward is pronounced.

topics.headline: headless relative retrieves the prior group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first word depends on 13:28 for its human referent, binding this reward statement to the preceding heart-rest description.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as a masculine plural relative pronoun, and the attachment evidence makes the reward predicate depend on this opening relative.

topics.headline: identity defined by predicates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that membership is defined by the following enacted predicates rather than by an inherited label.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun introduces the qualifying verbal clause before the reward predicate is stated.

topics.headline: plural chain anchors the recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one plural human group moving through the relative clause, two plural verbs, the pronoun, and the reward.
topics.reason: The verb and pronoun agreement keep the same plural referent active across the qualification and reward.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect plural, locally objectless, presenting trust as an achieved qualification
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, fidelity, and belief range; local Form IV selects committed trust while allowing the security field to color the reward movement

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opening masculine plural relative pronoun supplying the shared subject

words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) is a Form IV perfect with no explicit object, so the ayah presents trust as an achieved qualifying posture rather than narrowing it to one stated complement. The root field keeps belief close to security and entrusted fidelity, but the local form and coordination select committed trust, not mere passive safety. Its plural perfect ending links back to {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}), waits for the matching action verb, and carries the believing group across the 13:28 to 13:29 boundary from inner rest into outward qualification.

topics.headline: objectless Form IV trust
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb leaves the belief object unstated, making trust an absolute qualification in this clause.
topics.reason: The local verb is Form IV perfect and intransitive here, so broad object-capable claims are retained only as a contrast to the omitted local complement.

topics.headline: security and fidelity color belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief is not bare assent; the root field gives it security and fidelity pressure that prepares the blessing language.
topics.reason: The root range supports security and trust associations, while the local Form IV perfect selects the believing or trusting action.

topics.headline: completed plural qualification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the plural suffix carries the same group and presents belief as a settled qualification before the reward.
topics.reason: QAC parses the verb as third-person masculine plural perfect, with the relative pronoun as subject.

topics.headline: familiar formula gets rare reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a familiar belief-action formula is given a distinctive local closure by the rare reward word.
topics.reason: The local clause coordinates the belief verb with the action verb, and the CRITICAL rows supply the formulaic and boundary evidence.

words.gloss_range: coordinating clitic joining the two perfect verbs under the same relative subject
words.prose: The first {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) visibly and audibly attaches the second verb to the first, so belief and work become paired qualifications under one relative head. It does not make action a mere explanation of belief; it keeps the verbs parallel while allowing the same plural subject to carry across without being restated.

topics.headline: belief and action coordinated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first connector pairs belief and action without collapsing one into the other.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence both identify the particle as the coordinator linking the second verb to the first.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect plural action verb, transitive here with the explicit object of sound deeds
words.root_gloss_range: doing, working, performing, and producing range; local object selects purposeful enacted work rather than abstract intention or tool-employment

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: parallel perfect plural trust verb before the action verb
definite sound-deeds object governed by the action verb

words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) keeps the same plural subject as {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) and matches it as a perfect verb, so action is a co-condition rather than a later anecdote. Here the verb is transitive with {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāti}}) as its object, making the qualification concrete: trust issues in recognizable restorative deeds, not intention alone. The phrase also belongs to the familiar belief-action formula, while this ayah distinguishes that formula with the rare reward pivot that follows; the same-surah contrast with 13:18 keeps response, action, and reward in one field.

topics.headline: action parallels belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that action is grammatically parallel to belief under the same plural subject.
topics.reason: The verb is parsed as a third-person masculine plural perfect coordinated with the previous perfect.

topics.headline: work takes a specified object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not say only that they acted; it specifies work directed toward sound restorative deeds.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following noun as the explicit direct object of this verb.

topics.headline: work as accountable production
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb makes the believing group agents of enacted, accountable work.
topics.reason: The root's product and work field survives, while the local Form I finite verb rules out making this an instrument-employment sense.

topics.headline: formulaic hinge toward reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this verb is the hinge where trust becomes the established deed formula before the distinctive reward wording.
topics.reason: The verb sits between the trust verb and the sound-deeds object, matching the recurring phrase-formula.

words.gloss_range: definite feminine plural active-participle substantive functioning as the object of enacted work
words.root_gloss_range: soundness, rightness, repair, and reconciliation range; local object slot selects deed-validity and restorative action

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: transitive action verb governing the sound-deeds object

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāti}}) closes the qualifying beat as the object of {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}). Its definite plural form treats the deeds as a known category and distributes soundness across many enacted works rather than one abstract virtue. The root field adds repair, fitness, and reconciliation to the usual moral sense, so the work being rewarded is not generic activity but action that restores order; at the beat boundary, the assimilated emphatic onset gives the deed-category extra acoustic weight. This same repair field links with the surah-local thread at 13:23 and anticipates the beautiful-return language at the close.

topics.headline: known plural deed category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deeds are a definite recognized category functioning as the verb's object.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, plural, and syntactically attached as the object of the preceding verb.

topics.headline: participle becomes substantive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form means the sound or restorative things, not a visible local noun modified by an adjective.
topics.reason: QAC tags the word as an active participle used substantively, and no local modified noun is present.

topics.headline: soundness includes repair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deed category carries repair, fitness, and reconciliation pressure, not only a flat label of goodness.
topics.reason: The broader root field is retained as lexical pressure, while the local object slot selects deeds rather than abstract reconciliation alone.

topics.headline: condition closes before reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sound-deeds object is the threshold word before the reward opens.
topics.reason: The word ends the qualifying relative clause and completes the recurring work-plus-sound-deeds phrase.

words.gloss_range: nominative abstract reward noun, locally a verbless declaration or acclamation of blessedness
words.root_gloss_range: goodness, purity, wholesomeness, pleasantness, and fragrance range; local marked noun concentrates that field into a rare reward term

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opening relative pronoun whose referent becomes the reward recipient

words.prose: {{ar:طُوبَىٰ}} ({{tr:ṭūbā}}) is the reward pivot: after the long qualifying clause, one nominative nominal word turns condition into declaration. Its syntax keeps declarative blessedness and acclamatory force both live, and its unarticled form leaves abstract state and proper-name-like reward imagery open without forcing the tree reading. The root field of purity, wholesomeness, pleasantness, and fragrance makes the blessing sensory and qualitative, while the fuʿlā shape and exact-lexeme rarity make this familiar goodness field arrive in a uniquely concentrated form.

topics.headline: condition becomes reward declaration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the abrupt shift from verbal qualification into a verbless reward status.
topics.reason: The word begins the nominal reward statement after the relative clause and is predicated for the opening group.

topics.headline: declaration and acclamation remain open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word can be heard as both assigned blessedness and acclamation, while local syntax does not force a single concrete referent.
topics.reason: The nominative unarticled nominal supports more than one classical parse, but local grammar does not require replacing blessedness with a single proper-noun referent.

topics.headline: goodness made sensory
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reward is not abstract approval only; it carries purity, wholesomeness, and pleasantness pressure.
topics.reason: The root field supports goodness, purity, and pleasantness, while the local word is the marked reward noun rather than an ordinary adjective.

topics.headline: unique full-sounding reward word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a common goodness root is concentrated into a unique, acoustically expansive reward form.
topics.reason: The input marks the exact lexeme as unique while the root itself is not rare, preserving the contrast between familiar field and rare form.

words.gloss_range: preposition in the fused phrase assigning blessedness to the plural beneficiaries
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) turns the reward word into an assigned benefit: blessedness is for the qualified group, belongs to them, and completes the verbless predicate relation. Because it is fused directly to the pronoun, the first reward beat becomes compact and self-contained before the second reward phrase begins.

topics.headline: reward assigned through lām
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition does the predicative work of assigning blessedness to the recipients.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the preposition as governing the pronoun and completing the beneficiary complement of the reward noun.

topics.headline: short beat closes on recipient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the compression of reward and recipient into a short first reward beat.
topics.reason: The preposition and pronoun form the compact phrase that closes the first nominal reward unit.

words.gloss_range: third-person masculine plural pronoun governed by the lām and referring back to the qualified relative group

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opening relative pronoun whose referent becomes the reward recipient

words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) seals the first reward by routing the whole prior qualification into a compact recipient marker. The reward does not float as a general saying; it is directed back to the same plural group introduced by {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}). Its nasal close also gives the first reward beat an audible closure that the final tanwīn later answers.

topics.headline: pronoun closes the referent arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reward is assigned to the same qualified plural group rather than left abstract.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the pronoun as third-person masculine plural governed by the preposition and referring back to the opening relative group.

topics.headline: first reward beat closes audibly
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the short pronoun gives the first reward beat closure before the second reward is added.
topics.reason: The pronoun is the final element in the first reward phrase and the sound row adds a concrete cadence payoff.

words.gloss_range: second coordinating clitic adding the closing return phrase as another nominal reward predicate

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: closing beautiful-return phrase added as the second reward predicate
first nominal reward beat assigning blessedness to the qualified group

words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds {{ar:حُسْنُ مَـَٔابٍۢ}} ({{tr:ḥusnu maʾābin}}) to {{ar:طُوبَىٰ لَهُمْ}} ({{tr:ṭūbā lahum}}), so the return phrase is an additional reward predicate rather than a mere restatement. Together with the first connector, it gives the ayah a visible architecture: belief plus action answered by blessedness plus beautiful return, with coordination implying correspondence without an explicit causal particle.

topics.headline: second reward added
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final phrase is a second reward predicate, not merely an appositive restatement.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the closing phrase as coordinated with the first reward predicate.

topics.headline: two connectors map two pairs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah-level symmetry between the two qualifications and the two rewards.
topics.reason: The two coordinators link the verbal pair and then the reward pair, preserving a structural map without adding a causal particle.

words.gloss_range: nominative abstract construct head coordinating with the first reward and governing the return noun
words.root_gloss_range: beauty, goodness, excellence, and beneficent quality range; local construct applies that field to the return-destination

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first reward noun parallel to the closing construct head
genitive return noun governed by the construct head

words.prose: {{ar:حُسْنُ}} ({{tr:ḥusnu}}) begins the closing reward phrase as a nominative abstract noun, parallel to {{ar:طُوبَىٰ}} ({{tr:ṭūbā}}), while the construct grammar binds beauty or excellence directly to {{ar:مَـَٔابٍۢ}} ({{tr:maʾābin}}). The accepted accusative variant shows a real syntactic pressure point, but the standard reading keeps the phrase in the nominal reward chain. Lexically, the root fuses aesthetic beauty, moral goodness, and excellence, so the final outcome is not only useful or approved; the return itself is cast as beautiful-good. The recurring formula links this close with reward passages such as 3:14, 13:36, 38:25, and 38:49, and the ayah's opening trust is answered by closing excellence.

topics.headline: nominative construct joins reward chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that excellence itself is the construct head of the return phrase, not a detachable adjective.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as a nominative noun in construct with the following genitive return noun.

topics.headline: variant exposes case pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the standard nominative reading matters because an accepted accusative variant would make the closing phrase more exclamatory or specifying.
topics.reason: The variant is useful contrast evidence, while the canonical local parse remains nominative and construct-bound.

topics.headline: beauty and goodness fused
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final return is evaluated through beauty, goodness, and excellence together.
topics.reason: The root field supports aesthetic and moral value, while the construct with the return noun narrows the local sense to outcome-excellence.

topics.headline: recognized beautiful-return close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing phrase participates in a recognizable beautiful-return formula and bookends the opening trust with excellence.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete recurrence references and local structural placement for the formula.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive noun of place or time completing the beautiful-return construct at the ayah close
words.root_gloss_range: return, repeated return, destination, refuge, and outcome range; local construct selects a beautiful return-point while preserving motion toward return

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: construct head assigning beauty or excellence to the return noun

words.prose: {{ar:مَـَٔابٍۢ}} ({{tr:maʾābin}}) closes the ayah as the genitive complement of {{ar:حُسْنُ}} ({{tr:ḥusnu}}). Its indefiniteness leaves the return-destination open and magnified, while the mafʿal form allows place, time, or outcome of return rather than a merely spatial endpoint. The root keeps the end from sounding static: it is a return-point, a coming-back resolved into destination. Variant evidence shows how suffixing or nominative reparse would personalize or loosen the phrase, but the standard form keeps an indefinite governed return bound to beauty. As the final word, with medial hamza and tanwīn closure, it makes the ayah land on return; its constrained distribution marks the landing without making the noun a true hapax, and same-surah and formula links include 13:36.

topics.headline: indefinite return completes construct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final noun is both governed by excellence and left open-ended by indefiniteness.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence parse the word as indefinite genitive governed by the construct head.

topics.headline: return-point not static endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing destination carries the motion of return and can include place, time, or outcome.
topics.reason: The local noun of place/time licenses destination or outcome, while the broader return field remains lexical pressure rather than a claim of repeated local action.

topics.headline: variants test the standard dependency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the standard form avoids both speaker-owned return and independent nominative return, keeping the noun governed and general.
topics.reason: Variant readings are useful contrast evidence, but the local standard form remains indefinite and genitive in construct.

topics.headline: final beautiful-return landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah lands on a marked return noun whose beauty pairing, rarity, sound, and final position converge.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows connect the word's final position, co-occurrence with beauty, constrained distribution, same-surah echo, and sound closure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of belief, intended action, repaired action, inward good, and return.
baseline_models.mechanism: Trusted inner security issues in deliberate repair; repair ripens into willing inward ease and an attractive homecoming.

activation_trace.role: Security and trusted stillness make belief the mechanism's settled starting condition.
Purposive action carries inner security into an intended deed.
Repair against corruption specifies what the intended deed accomplishes.
The soul's willing ease makes the good an uncoerced inward state, not merely an award.
Desired beauty qualifies the return as experientially attractive.
Return to a gathering place closes the causal arc as homecoming.

changed_reading.before: A formula promising reward after belief and good deeds.
changed_reading.after: A causal arc in which trusted repose becomes deliberate repair and culminates in a freely welcomed homecoming.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural repaired acts and the beneficiaries marked by 'for them'.
baseline_models.mechanism: Deliberate dealings remove estrangement and restore fit between people; the result is a return to a relation one can inhabit without coercion.

activation_trace.role: Human transaction supplies the social field in which the deeds operate.
Removing interpersonal estrangement makes reconciliation the deeds' function.
Suitability adds restored fit rather than generic moral approval.
Unforced satisfaction marks the repaired relation as willingly inhabitable.
Gathering back into a place renders the outcome a social homecoming.

changed_reading.before: Private merit accumulated by separate individuals.
changed_reading.after: Relational labor that restores fit and lets a plural community return to an inhabitable bond.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coupling of work with return permits an embodied route model.
baseline_models.mechanism: Working limbs traverse a worked road, while their repeated motion already rehearses the return named at the end; destination and recurrent reorientation coexist.

activation_trace.role: Working limbs give the deed an embodied carrier.
A worked, traversed road turns action into an itinerary.
Travelers proceeding on foot keep the itinerary materially enacted.
The limbs' recurrent return in travel makes homecoming a repeated motion as well as an endpoint.
Arrival from multiple directions keeps more than one route into the return open.
Utmost exertion qualifies the route as sustained effort rather than passive transport.

changed_reading.before: A static destination reached only after deeds are complete.
changed_reading.after: Each embodied stride can rehearse return, while the final homecoming remains the beautiful completion of the route.

context_deltas.mechanism: Running on an established course toward an appointed limit, under management that considers outcomes, recasts return as a governed trajectory that reaches an encounter.

activation_trace.role: Homeward return supplies the focus endpoint to be dynamically revised.
An established running course supplies ordered motion toward the endpoint.
An appointed temporal limit gives the course a bounded arrival.
Management by considering the consequence links present motion to its end.
The meeting of two counterparts renders arrival an encounter, not mere stoppage.

structural_cues: 13:2 orders course, appointed term, outcome-aware management, and encounter in one progression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies course, limit, consequence, and meeting; I map that progression onto the focus return. The live alternative is that it only grounds certainty about cosmic order.

changed_reading.before: Return as an abrupt terminal reward.
changed_reading.after: Return as the meeting reached by a governed course whose present movement already faces its appointed outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: Neighboring growths from shared origins receive one irrigation yet issue distinct yields; repaired acts become situated cultivation whose goodness is tested by fitting, nourishing fruit.

activation_trace.role: Intended work anchors cultivation back in the focus deeds.
Fitness makes goodness responsive to the plot rather than mechanically uniform.
Wholesome, desirable quality names the kind of yield that counts as good.
Neighboring proximity creates comparable but distinct sites of growth.
Cultivation and growth supply the productive process assigned to action.
Shoots issuing from one root hold origin constant while outcomes vary.
Irrigation supplies the common enabling input.
Unity in one direction keeps the water-source condition shared.
Agricultural yield provides the observable test of cultivated fitness.

structural_cues: 13:4 holds adjacency and water constant while distinguishing edible outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies common input, distinct plots, and differentiated yield; I treat deeds as the cultivation that mediates input into fruit. Alternatively, the ecology may illustrate signs without defining action.

changed_reading.before: Righteous acts as a uniform checklist.
changed_reading.after: Righteous acts as context-sensitive cultivation: shared provision becomes diverse but fitting and nourishing yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured flow separates buoyant display from useful residue that remains in fertile ground; repair is tested by durable benefit rather than surface volume.

activation_trace.role: Repair against corruption anchors the assay in the focus acts.
Wholesome quality names the retained result rather than its showy surface.
Fitting a thing to its measure makes the assay proportional to each channel.
Floating foam supplies conspicuous but nonretained output.
Benefit opposed to harm defines the material that passes the assay.
Stable remaining with waiting makes durability part of goodness.
Fertile ground is the receiving medium in which retained benefit can continue working.

structural_cues: 13:17 explicitly stages flow, surface separation, disappearance, and useful remainder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a material separation of foam from lasting benefit; I apply that assay to the focus deeds. The live alternative confines the image to truth and falsehood in discourse.

changed_reading.before: Any visibly good performance qualifies as a righteous deed.
changed_reading.after: A deed qualifies by the useful residue it leaves after display falls away, especially what remains productive in its receiving ground.

context_deltas.mechanism: Haste advances the bad before the good, while patient good later functions as a counterforce against bad; the beautiful return is produced through reversal, not simple accumulation.

activation_trace.role: Repair against corruption anchors reversal as a function of the focus deeds.
Hasty advancement supplies the temporal disorder in which bad is demanded first.
Ugliness and badness name the force that repair must reverse.
Doing good supplies the opposed constructive force.
Holding the self against panic supplies the delay required for constructive reversal.
Beneficent action becomes the active means rather than a decorative quality.
Badness is the affected object, keeping the mechanism corrective.

structural_cues: 13:6 places the bad before the good under haste.
The branchless root د ر ء at 13:22 word 13 is used only as the structural cue that good acts upon bad.

1. `ط ي ب/B001` is good, pure, pleasant, and wholesome against foulness. `طُوبَى` follows belief plus sound action and precedes good return. I infer blessed pleasantness as the experiential quality produced by integrated practice, not an unspecified prize alone.
2. `ن و ب/B001` gives recurrent return, activated through `مَآب` and 13:27's `أَنَابَ`. I infer that the final destination consummates a repeatedly practiced return.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 13:35 later materialized wholesome return as an enduring productive habitat rather than a merely affective state.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Intentional work produces soundness that can survive return.** `ع م ل / B001` is intentional doing and work, `ص ل ح / B001` is soundness against corruption, `ط ي ب / B001` is good and pure opposite foul, and `ء و ب / B001` is turning back to a return-place. The sentence moves from faith through work and sound products to purity and a good return. Nearby 13:25 supplies corruption as the inverse output, 13:28 supplies recurrent heart-stabilization, 13:30 turns trust toward a return, and 13:33 places each self under what it acquired. I assign work the role of transforming orientation into durable products, purity the role of their tested quality, and return the role of evaluation. The packet supplies action, soundness, and destination; I infer repeated intentional work -> a returnable condition that is not discarded. `طُوبَى` thus reads as purified outcome rather than an uncaused reward word.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 13:33's `بِمَا كَسَبَتْ` made intentional work retrospectively leave an acquired, accountable trace. 13:34 then showed the opposed trajectory's return as increasing strain, sharpening `حسن مآب` as the quality of what one's work can carry back.

facets.statement: Bir kişi veya şeyin güzel ve beğenilir olması, çirkinliğin karşıtı olan temel anlamdır.
Olumlu değerlendirme akla, kişisel eğilime veya duyulara dayanabilir; dal yalnızca görsel güzellikle sınırlı değildir.
İnsanlar güzel diye nitelenebilir ve aynı nitelik çok yüksek derecede güzelliği belirten biçimlerle güçlendirilebilir.
Bir insanın, işin veya başka bir şeyin güzel yerleri ve iyi nitelikleri, onun kötü yanlarının karşıtı olarak topluca anılabilir.

Eylem kişinin kendi işine yöneldiğinde işi iyi, doğru ve ustalıkla yapmayı belirtir.
Bir şeyi daha güzel duruma getirme, iyi eylemin nesne üzerinde sonuç doğuran biçimidir.
İyilik etme, kimi kullanımda yalnızca denk karşılığı vermekle yetinmeyip bunun üzerine çıkmayı gerektirir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimsenin ya da şeyin geldiği yere, yerleştiği yere veya varacağı dönüş noktasına geri dönmesi; bundan hareketle dönüşün kendisi, dönüş zamanı ya da dönüş yeri de anlatılır. Bazı kullanımlarda anlam, suyun veya öğütülen şeyin toplandığı belirli yerle sınırlıdır.

facets.statement: Temel çekirdek, bir kişinin veya şeyin geri dönmesi ve önceki ya da beklenen varış yerine yönelmesidir.
Dönüşün kendisi yanında dönüş zamanı ve dönüş yeri de aynı anlam alanına girer.
Kuyu ortasında suyun toplandığı yer veya değirmende unun çıktığı yer gibi kullanımlar belirli yer adlarıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi el ve ayakların yürüyüşte gidip gelmesi, gündüz yol alma, elin kılıca ya da oka dönmesi ve hızlı geri salınan deve eli gibi hareket kullanımlarını birlikte veriyor. Provisional çerçeve bu kullanımları doğru topluyor, fakat bunlar genel dönüş anlamı değil hareket düzenine bağlı özel kullanımlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yürüyüş ve el hareketi gibi bedensel ya da yol alma bağlamlarına bağlıdır; genel eve dönüş anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam hem türemiş biçimleri hem de belirli söz öbeklerini içerir; tanım çıplak dönüşle bu hareket kalıplarını birleştirmez.

concept_map.definition: Yürüyüşte el ve ayakların gidip gelmesi ya da hızlı salınması, yolculuğun gündüz boyunca sürdürülmesi ve elin kılıç veya oka doğru geri götürülmesi gibi hareket düzenleridir. Bu dalda dönüş çekirdeği, bedensel salınım veya belirli yol alma biçimi olarak özelleşir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, hareket eden uzvun geri gelip tekrar yönelmesi veya gidip gelmesidir.
Yürüyüşte el ve ayakların hızlı çevrilmesi veya salınması bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmesidir.
Gündüz boyunca yol alma ve gece konaklama kullanımı, yolculuk düzenine bağlı ayrı bir kullanım olarak kalır.
Elin kılıca veya okun bulunduğu yere geri götürülmesi bu hareket çekirdeğinin örneklerindendir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalda uzuvların yürüyüşte gidip gelmesini, hızlı el ve ayak hareketini, gündüz yol almayı ve elin silaha ya da oka yönelmesini aynı hareket alanında toplar. Ortak nokta, genel dönüşten çok tekrarlı ya da hedefli geri hareketin belirli bağlamlara uygulanmasıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir kalıpta, insanların her yönden ya da her taraftan gelmesini anlatıyor. Provisional çerçeve bu söz öbeği sınırını doğru koruyor ve bunu genel dönüş veya yürüyüş hareketiyle karıştırmıyor.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnız her yön, her taraf anlamındaki söz öbeğine bağlıdır; çıplak dönüş anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam söz öbeğidir; tanım sadece her yönden gelme kalıbına uygulanır ve çıplak kök anlamına genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğun her yönden, her taraftan veya çeşitli yönlerden gelmesini anlatan söz öbeği kullanımıdır. Buradaki anlam dönüş değil, gelişin yönlerinin çokluğudur.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, gelişin tek bir yönden değil her yönden gerçekleşmesidir.
Anlam, belirli söz öbeğinde yön veya taraf anlamıyla sınırlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak biçimde bu kalıbı her yönden veya her taraftan gelme diye açıklar. Dönüş çekirdeği burada bağımsız bir eylem olarak değil, yön anlamına dönüşmüş söz öbeği içinde kalır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir gelişin farklı yönlerden veya her taraftan gerçekleştiği söz öbeği bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Her yön veya her taraf anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsanların veya bir topluluğun çeşitli yönlerden geldiği cümlelerde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Çok yönlü geliş anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de yön, taraf veya yan anlam alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal gelişin çok yönlülüğünü anlatan sabit kalıptır; komşu dal taraf veya uç anlamını geliş koşulu olmadan daha geniş kullanır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal gelişin yönlerini ifade eder; komşu dal kişinin veya şeyin geri dönmesini ve dönülen yeri ifade eder.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dağlara yönelik emir bağlamında Tanrı'yı yüceltme sözünü yinelemek veya karşılık vermek anlamını gösteriyor. Provisional çerçeve bunu duyusal geri dönüşten ve gündüz yol alıştan ayırarak doğru sınırlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnız kutsal övgünün tekrarlanması veya karşılık verilmesi bağlamındadır; fiziksel dönüş değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam belirli bağlamdaki emir biçimiyle türemiş ad kullanımını birlikte taşır; tanım dini sesli yineleme alanıyla sınırlanır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, kutsal övgünün sesle yinelenmesi veya ona karşılık verilmesidir.
Kullanım, dağlara yönelen emir bağlamındaki birlikte yüceltme söyleyişine bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalı kutsal övgüyü seslendirme veya yineleme olarak açıklar ve verilen hitap bağlamına bağlar. Ortak anlam fiziksel dönüş değil, övgü sözünün karşılıklı ya da tekrarlı seslendirilmesidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi gece gelme, geceleyin birine uğrama ve geceyle birlikte geri dönen kişi anlamlarını bir arada veriyor. Provisional çerçeve doğru; ancak bu dal genel dönüş değil, zaman koşulu gece olan geliş veya dönüş kullanımıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi güneşin batışını, batma yerine yönelmesini ve doğu ile batı arasındaki günlük gidişini anlatıyor. Provisional çerçeve bunu doğru sınırlar; anlam insan ya da hayvan dönüşü değil, güneşin batıya yönelen kayboluşudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal güneşe ve onun batıya doğru gidip batmasına bağlıdır; genel dönüş veya dini dönüş değildir.

root_profile.summary: Bu kökün dalları geri dönme çekirdeği etrafında örgütlenir: genel dönüş ve dönüş yeri, dini yöneliş, yürüyüşte geri salınım, her yönden gelme, kutsal övgünün yinelenmesi, geceleyin gelme ve güneşin batıya varıp batması. Anlamlar ortak dönüş hissinden beslenir, fakat çoğu dal belirli bağlam, zaman, söz öbeği veya katılımcıyla sınırlanır.

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.
